name: deprioritized_initiative
description: A parent whose importance was lowered after the fact, alongside a parent that stayed important -- children of the deprioritized one must drop accordingly. The scenario the roadmap names explicitly.

nodes.label: Leaf under the still-important initiative, same own importance

notes: Same own importance (0.5) for both leaves -- only the parent's importance differs, and that alone must decide the order. A propagation model that ignores a lowered parent importance would get this wrong.
